text:
ashley: Quick proposal — introduce lightweight 'cost_window' events plus explicit 'commit_marker' events on the metering topic so downstream billing reconciler has a clear durable checkpoint to close windows across regions. Sketch below.

vik: sounds promising. how do you see this interacting with the current compacting path?

ashley: goal is to keep per-request usage events unchanged, but emit a second stream with windowed summaries + a marker event when all partitions have acked the ledger for that window. this avoids expensive cross-joins during reconciliation.

mike: two quick concerns: 1) idempotency of window summaries (we need stable ids) 2) hooks for late-arriving tokens.

ashley: agreed. stable id is simply checkpoint_id = sha1(window_start + tenant + topology_version). late arrivals should be emitted as delta 'correction' events (same schema) which reconciler applies when seen.

sara: audit question — do we keep raw events forever or rely on summary+corrections for audits? retention tradeoff there.

mike: prefer short raw retention (30d) and longer summary retention (1y) plus immutable commit_markers for forensic signals. keeps storage reasonable but preserves audit trail.

ashley: example event shapes: 
```json
{
  "type": "usage",
  "tenant_id": "t-42",
  "request_id": "r-abc123",
  "tokens": 452,
  "model": "gpt-open-13b",
  "timestamp": "2025-03-01T10:02:12Z",
  "fingerprint": "fp_9a8b"
}

{
  "type": "cost_window",
  "checkpoint_id": "ck_20250301_10_t-42_v3",
  "tenant_id": "t-42",
  "window_start": "2025-03-01T10:00:00Z",
  "window_end": "2025-03-01T10:05:00Z",
  "tokens_total": 125000,
  "token_breakdown": {"prompt": 80000, "completion": 45000},
  "derived_at": "2025-03-01T10:05:02Z"
}

{
  "type": "commit_marker",
  "checkpoint_id": "ck_20250301_10_t-42_v3",
  "window_start": "2025-03-01T10:00:00Z",
  "window_end": "2025-03-01T10:05:00Z",
  "parts_ack": ["us-west-1", "eu-central-1"],
  "signature": "sig_..."
}
```

vik: neat. query/perf note: if we partition cost_window by tenant+checkpoint_id, lookups for corrections are O(1). but compaction needs to fold corrections into summary — we should define a local merge fn.

mike: local merge fn idea: fold by checkpoint_id, apply corrections by timestamp, store merged_summary with last_correction_ts. corrections older than retention cutoff drop. also expose a tombstone when a summary is superseded.

sara: operationally we need a reconciler job that watches commit_marker sequence per-tenant and only finalizes invoice windows when marker is seen from all expected partitions. what happens on missing markers?

ashley: fallback: if marker missing after grace window, reconciler emits a 'partial_commit' with partitions_missing field and triggers async repair job. also surfaces alert in Console.

billing-bot: FYI — ran local sim with 100 tenants, markers reduced cross-region reconcile time by ~82% in prototype. details: https://ci.internal/sim/1755554444

mike: nice. next steps: 1) RFC doc with exact schema + merge semantics (owner: ashley) 2) prototype deploy to staging (owner: vik) 3) reconciliation test harness for partial_commit scenarios (owner: sara).

ashley: I'll draft RFC today and ping eng-qa for sim. will include migration plan for older compacted ledgers (backfill vs translate on read).

vik: 👍 if ashley posts RFC by EOD I'll allocate staging window next week.

sara: add a checklist item to validate audit exports for compliance (owner: sara).

mike: thanks — keeping this lightweight will help ops adoption.

ashley: cool, marking as follow-up in eng-platform board and adding owners.
